author: KEXP
description: The latest release from British Columbia's Ora Cogan is an intimate and shimmering set of experimental folk sorcery. In the KEXP Live Room, she shares the magic of 'Hard Hearted Woman' with a performance of "The Smoke" and more.
title: Ora Cogan performs "The Smoke" & more Live on KEXP
